facts.fact: Clara 醒来发现还在 1901 房间，先在梦/昏迷/现实之间挣扎，最后承认可能真的被困。
仆人 Annabelle 转达 Ben 的问候——他已经等了两个小时，Clara 磨蹭到十一点多才起床。
facts.anchor: Mr. Mitchell wanted to make sure you’re feeling well.

facts.fact: Clara 靠历史研究背景挑对日装，想起 Aunt Vi 曾质疑研究学位和历史博客有什么用。
facts.anchor: And to think that Aunt Vi worried about what use my research degree and my historical blog could be.

facts.fact: 原貌浴室：爪足瓷浴缸对门、旁边是立柱式洗手池。
facts.anchor: A clawed, porcelain tub sits opposite the door, and there’s a pedestal sink next to it.

facts.fact: Clara 意识到穿越的日常代价：没有干洗香波，洗头成为难题。
facts.anchor: like how much you’ll miss dry shampoo

facts.fact: Ben 坐姿现代（肘撑膝盖撕报纸），Clara 意识到自己是他在 1901 唯一能卸下伪装的对象。
facts.anchor: at least I’m a safe place for Ben to be himself when he has to act around everyone else

facts.fact: Ben 宣布去旧金山：买衣服与合身 corset，还赶上 McKinley 总统明天到访。
facts.anchor: President McKinley is also going to be in San Francisco tomorrow

facts.fact: 失踪案细节：车在、手机在柜台上、屋内无翻动、无强行闯入，警察倾向「抛弃生活」说。
facts.anchor: There was no explanation. Your car was there, your phone was sitting on the counter, nothing in the apartment was disturbed, no forced entry.

facts.fact: Ben 是 Western Civ 博士，原计划失踪那年上大学任教。
facts.anchor: And my doctorate. I was supposed to start teaching at the college the year I disappeared. Western Civ.

facts.fact: 镜子装进特制木箱随行——Ben 到哪都带着镜子，仆人早已习惯这种怪癖。
facts.anchor: One of the many eccentricities the staff are used to here,” he says in a low voice. “I take the mirror everywhere I go.
